the development of high speed serial data links for the future generation of high energy physics experiments, which require data transmission over long distances with high speed and low jitter.

the ASICs are well suited for high-speed serial data transmission in high energy physics experiments.
both designs are fully functional and can be used in a future detector front-end.
the serializer can be operated up to 5 Gbps, with a measured output jitter of 0.5 ps, while the PLL can be used up to 5 GHz with an output jitter below 0.3 ps, both at room temperature.
